note: Curated HISTORICAL DAMAGE record for the dashboard's Past-events view — SEPARATE from ramban_documented_landslides.geojson (the validated back-test inventory), which is deliberately untouched. Verification rule (CLAUDE.md / ledger §12g, §36-§38): every event is checked against a primary source (peer-reviewed paper or GSI) or 2+ independent press outlets; publication date != event date; LOW-confidence rows are flagged review_needed for the user and rendered as pending review, never as settled fact. Ranking = deaths desc, then injured, then damage_score (0-10 editorial judgment of infrastructure/livelihood damage, used only to break ties among non-fatal events). Coordinates are approximate place centroids (same convention as the back-test inventory), NOT field-mapped scarps.

events.name: Khooni Nallah T3 tunnel-portal collapse (Digdol–Panthyal four-laning)
events.damage: Landslide + shooting stones during portal-support work collapsed the false steel portal onto the under-construction tunnel; 10 workers killed; contractor fined Rs 8.46 crore and barred from central projects for 6 months
events.trigger: Slope failure / rock-mass fall during construction (night ~22:30 IST; not reported as rainfall-triggered)
events.confidence_reason: Multiple independent national outlets consistent on date, location and toll; central-government probe and contractor fine on public record

sources.label: Business Standard, 12 Oct 2022 (Rs 8.5 cr fine for collapse that killed 10)

events.name: 20 April 2025 Ramban cloudburst (Seri Bagna / Kela Morh / Battery Chashma)
events.coord_confidence: approximate_place_centroid (Seri Bagna, where the deaths occurred)
events.damage: NH-44 washed away at ~5 locations over a 10 km Karol→Marog stretch (incl. Kela Morh/T-2 approach and Battery Chashma, vehicles swept into gorges); 3 deaths at Seri Bagna; schools closed district-wide
events.trigger: Verified deadly cloudburst, night of 19–20 Apr (~100 mm/1 hr localized, 40 mm/3 hr, 60–140 mm/day) — the ledger §12g corrected-date event
events.confidence_reason: Peer-reviewed (Springer Landslides 2025; ScienceDirect 2026) + multi-outlet press; the date itself was re-verified in the §12g correction exercise

events.name: Pernote land subsidence (Ramban–Gool road)
events.coord_confidence: approximate_place_centroid (~3 km from Ramban town on the Gool road; LOW spatial precision)
events.damage: Slow-moving subsidence/slope deformation destroyed or damaged ~60 houses, roads and power infrastructure in Neemnar/Telka wards; ~500 people affected and displaced to relief camps; agricultural land lost
events.trigger: Land subsidence over days (attributed in reporting to slope conditions, unplanned construction and wastewater seepage); no single storm trigger
events.confidence_reason: Multiple independent outlets consistent on date, wards, ~60 houses and ~500 affected; long-running rehabilitation coverage corroborates scale

sources.label: Zee News, Apr 2024 (houses damaged, roads cracked)

events.damage: NH-44 shut by a heavy landslide near Digdol/Khooni Nallah (per the 27 Apr report)
events.trigger: Unclear — very likely follow-up reporting on the 20 Apr cloudburst damage rather than a distinct new failure (ledger §12g date-correction finding)
